name: MLB Dodgers rolling 10-game run rate (team form), 2024 daily
citation: MLB Dodgers rolling 10-game run rate (team form), 2024 daily. Data obtained from Retrosheet 2024 game logs (gl2024.zip), www.retrosheet.org/gamelogs/. The information used here was obtained free of charge from and is copyrighted by Retrosheet. Interested parties may contact Retrosheet at www.retrosheet.org.

description: Trailing 10-game average runs scored (smoothed team form/momentum) for the 2024 Los Angeles Dodgers, with rolled offensive box-score covariates. Application: form/momentum forecasting ("are we trending up or down?"). Target = rolling 10-game mean runs.
preprocessing: 1. Per-game Dodgers 2024 box-score series extracted from Retrosheet game logs; one value per game.
2. Reshaped to TempusBench long format: one row per variable with columns variable_name, variable_unit, timestamps, values.
3. Games re-indexed to consecutive daily dates; timestamps emitted as ISO-8601 UTC strings (00:00:00Z), shared across all variables.

4. Variable and unit names written in plain English (spaces, no underscores); the target_ prefix dropped. No calendar/time-feature covariates are included — the only notion of time is the shared timestamps list.
5. 10-game rolling runs scored (target, runs): Trailing 10-game average of runs scored
6. 10-game rolling hits (covariate, hits): Trailing 10-game average of hits
7. 10-game rolling home runs (covariate, home runs): Trailing 10-game average of home runs
8. 10-game rolling walks (covariate, walks): Trailing 10-game average of walks
